svg.title: Time to first token in default chat
svg.desc: Core suite median internal TTFT, with 32 first replies and 32 follow-ups per engine per campaign. Both panels have the same zero-based linear scale. Excludes loading, tokenization and terminal transport. Guffin improves all six medians; individual first prompts can still favor llama.cpp. Values in seconds: {"First replies": {"gemma2-release-v2": {"guffin": 0.4089245, "llama": 0.653895}, "gemma3-normal-release-v2": {"guffin": 0.6124545, "llama": 0.80305}, "gemma3-speculative-release": {"guffin": 0.612609, "llama": 0.807725}}, "Follow-ups": {"gemma2-release-v2": {"guffin": 0.2550725, "llama": 2.528645}, "gemma3-normal-release-v2": {"guffin": 0.4525645, "llama": 1.307855}, "gemma3-speculative-release": {"guffin": 0.4551535, "llama": 1.30331}}}
